run_groq_llm_simple_complete: run a Groq LLM to get a simple non-streaming completion response from llama3-8b-8192
run_groq_llm_stream_complete: run a Groq LLM to get a streaming completion response with incremental token output
run_groq_llm_chat_with_system_prompt: run a Groq LLM chat with a system prompt and user message using ChatMessage objects
review_groq_llm_chatbot: review the Groq LlamaIndex chatbot script that demonstrates simple, streaming, and system-prompt chat modes
refactor_groq_llm_chatbot: refactor the Groq LlamaIndex chatbot to add conversation history or switch to a different model
